prompts.warrior: Use case: stylized-concept. Production PIXEL ART fantasy RPG hotbar icon ATLAS, sharp chunky square pixels like carefully hand-drawn 32x32 SNES inventory sprites enlarged with nearest neighbor, limited rich palette, strong readable silhouettes at 48px. NOT smooth vector, NOT painterly, NOT realistic. Exact equal cell grid fills entire canvas edge to edge. Each cell has identical solid very dark blue-green background #102528, NO frames, NO labels, NO text, NO numbers, NO lettering. Every icon isolated centered within its own cell with 12% empty margin, never overlaps neighboring cells. Distinct colorful spell pictograms, bright pixel highlights and pixelated magic energy, professional game UI. Read cells left to right, top to bottom. EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows = 12 square icons. Row1: (1) warrior CLASS portrait: brown-haired heroic knight head and shoulders in blue-silver armor with gold trim; (2) basic sword slash silver sword diagonal blue crescent; (3) second combo slash two silver crossed swords with aqua streaks; (4) heavy third combo silver sword smashing downward with amber flash. Row2: (5) whirlwind slash silver sword encircled by blue spiral; (6) quickdraw katana emerging from dark scabbard bright horizontal white-blue cutting flash; (7) earth cleaver huge sword striking jagged golden ground fissure and brown rock shards; (8) charge thrust silver sword pointing horizontally right with long cobalt spear-shaped pressure wave. Row3: (9) rising dragon slash: coiling azure dragon head rising with golden horns; (10) white TIGER head lunging right with electric blue flames; (11) sacred sword: single upright radiant golden sword with white wing-shaped aura; (12) sword rain: THREE large silver-gold swords pointing vertically down, staggered heights, blue sky beams and tiny gold impact sparks. Maintain true visible pixel clusters.
